description: IPv6 solicited-node multicast address, ff02::1:ffXX:XXXX, from the low 24 bits of an IPv6 address or from the last three octets of a MAC. The U/L flip does not change those 24 bits, so the MAC and its SLAAC address share one solicited-node address. Hex groups only; no zone index. Price: $0.001 USDC per successful call (x402, Solana). Same tool over HTTPS: GET https://scorptech.it.com/api/x402/v1/solicited-node
